You can usually do this by clicking “Forgot password?” on the login page, entering your email address (or username), and following the instructions sent to you. Once you receive the reset link, you’ll be able to set a new password and then log in normally. If you run into any trouble during the reset process, let me know and I’ll help guide you through it.
